bio: Chef Jean-François Pantaleon has opened a second restaurant a few metres from Roza, his fine dining restaurant, also in the Graslin area, near the Musée Dobrée archaeology museum. This vintage bistro has a friendly atmosphere where you can enjoy a down-to-earth meal. In addition to the reasonably priced lunch menu, classic suggestions are written on the mirrors: eggs mayonnaise, terrine, calf's head or veal chop with mashed potatoes. The evening menu features additional dishes designed for sharing, although you might not want to. Simple, traditional, well-made food – the perfect complement to Roza....
